title: Selection principles and the Scheepers diagram in an uncountable setting
summary: We continue the study of selection principles in the uncountable setting initiated in [18] and further developed in [1]. We investigate several problems posed in [1] concerning the Scheepers diagram, the $κ$-Hurewicz Conjecture, and related questions on $κ$-Menger and $K_κ$-spaces. We determine the Scheepers diagram in the uncountable setting up to three unresolved implications and compute the critical cardinalities of several properties occurring in the diagram.
